# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — Mcp Tunnels

> 10 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Mcp Tunnels. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Mcp Tunnels

- [Archive Tunnel](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/archive.md): Archive a tunnel. Archival is irreversible.
- [Archive Tunnel Certificate](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/tunnel_certificates/archive.md): Archive a certificate, removing it from the set Anthropic trusts for this tunnel.
- [Create Tunnel Certificate](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/tunnel_certificates/create.md): Register a public CA certificate for the tunnel.
- [Get Tunnel](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/retrieve.md): Retrieve a single tunnel in the caller's organization by ID.
- [Get Tunnel Certificate](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/tunnel_certificates/retrieve.md): Retrieve a single certificate registered on a tunnel by ID.
- [List Tunnel Certificates](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/tunnel_certificates/list.md): Include archived certificates in the results. Archived certificates are excluded by default.
- [List Tunnels](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/list.md): Include archived tunnels in the results. Archived tunnels are excluded by default.
- [Reveal Tunnel Token](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/reveal_token.md): Stable identifier for the current token value. Changes when the token is rotated.
- [Rotate Tunnel Token](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/rotate_token.md): Stable identifier for the current token value. Changes when the token is rotated.
- [Tunnel Certificates](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels/tunnel_certificates.md): Include archived certificates in the results. Archived certificates are excluded by default.
